notes.title: Patch V8.0
notes.content:
in this update we worked on:
- brightness levels for all the areas, increased visibility, and light sources.
- fixes to collision issues with crouching.
- better detection from Phillip; who is able to see in more angles now.
- removed events and replaced them with others.
- character movement fix.
- camera overlay issue that was causing an issue while hiding.
- particles to indicate when the player is making noise when stepping on paper.
